title: [EPLB] Reduce EPLB Inference Overhead (#24573)

image.wheel_note: first PyPI release after merge (2025-10-04 > 2025-09-22); picked by gen_tasks.py from PyPI upload dates.

workload.note: FusedMoE.select_experts (static) with enable_eplb=True on synthetic routing: 256 logical / 288 physical experts (32 replicated), top_k 8, M=64 and 1024; baseline = torch.rand replica pick + masks inline, PR's solution = torch.compile'd eplb_map_to_physical_and_record. Wall-clock us per call. Author numbers are DP16 DeepSeek-V3 serving w/ EPLB main vs PR (reported-only).

policy.one_run_is: one `docker run` of the workload cmd per arm per repeat (same image, arm tree swapped in by the prelude)

contention_gate.rules: wait while another tenant uses the GPU (>5 % util or a foreign compute process >1 GiB) or the CPU (load1 > nproc/2)

policy.machine_snapshot: machine.py snapshot per workload run -> data/pr_<n>/work/machine_<arm>_<i>.json

arm_isolation.tree: wipe the wheel's vllm/*.py, copy the arm's vllm/ over site-packages (compiled .so stay)
arm_isolation.files: overlay ONLY task.json:source_files from the arm over the wheel's own tree
arm_isolation.tests_benchmarks: copied from the PR's merge tree to /t without a sibling vllm/ package

policy.noise_model: measure.py: paired log-speedup, MAD sigma, theta = clip(k*sigma, theta_min, theta_max) with k/theta from config.yaml:measure

metrics.name: serving_request_throughput
metrics.parse: Request throughput (not measured: DeepSeek-V3 DP16 w/ EPLB)

headline: eplb_select_experts_m64

reported.gain_evidence: **Summary:** Not accounting for the benefits of improved expert load balancing, on the main branch, EPLB introduces ~3.97% throughput drop.
reported.experiments_note: reported = numbers from the PR body (author's machine)

author_hardware_args.text: We benchmarked **1000 random prompts** with **1000 input tokens** and **100 output tokens** on DeepSeek-V3-0324, on a DP16 setting. Prefix caching was disabled to measure the raw computational cost.

Not accounting for the benefits of improved expert load balancing, on the main branch, EPLB introduces ~3.97% throughput drop. With this PR, we recover ~2.41%, narrowing the gap to **~1.66%** compared to running without EPLB.

standalone.run_baseline: docker run --rm --gpus device=0 --shm-size=2g -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1 -v $PWD/data/pr_24573:/task:ro -v $PWD/.weights/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface -e ARM=baseline vllm-task:24573 -lc 'A=/base; site=$(python3 -c "import vllm,os;print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__)))"); find "$site/vllm" -name "*.py" -delete; cp -a $A/vllm/. "$site/vllm/"; ln -sfn $A /src; rm -rf /t && mkdir -p /t && cd /gold && for d in tests benchmarks pyproject.toml conftest.py; do [ -e "$d" ] && cp -a "$d" /t/; done; cd /t; python3 /task/bench.py'
standalone.run_pr_solution: docker run --rm --gpus device=0 --shm-size=2g -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID -e HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1 -v $PWD/data/pr_24573:/task:ro -v $PWD/.weights/hf:/root/.cache/huggingface -e ARM=pr_solution vllm-task:24573 -lc 'A=/gold; site=$(python3 -c "import vllm,os;print(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__)))"); find "$site/vllm" -name "*.py" -delete; cp -a $A/vllm/. "$site/vllm/"; ln -sfn $A /src; rm -rf /t && mkdir -p /t && cd /gold && for d in tests benchmarks pyproject.toml conftest.py; do [ -e "$d" ] && cp -a "$d" /t/; done; cd /t; python3 /task/bench.py'
standalone.note: The image already holds both trees (/base = baseline commit, /gold = the PR's merge commit); the one-liner swaps the chosen tree over the installed wheel exactly like run_one.sh's prelude, then runs the workload cmd from /t (the merge tree's tests/ + benchmarks/).

test_note: perf-only EPLB tail rewrite; no test in the diff; PR's solution torch.compiles the tail (gcc in image).
